'''Veemo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] officer in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], Veemo was a [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]] who could be found on the frozen ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

==Behind the scenes==
Officer Veemo appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Mods Vendor for Republic players on Hoth.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Veemo was removed from the game along with the rest of the Mods Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
